title: Work Exists, Result Not Found
claim: The image-optimizer parity objective is being progressed and closed by continued research, construction, validation, and audit rounds.

observed_evidence.detail: Research rounds R1-R8, a MILP construction, candidate-construction logic, seals, receipts, roots, and audits exist and the construction is internally verified.
At the incident boundary another process-only round is proposed while the outcome-producing encode is again deferred.

missing_evidence.detail: No encoded output candidate exists: the outcome-producing action was never executed and the encoded-candidate count is zero.
No exact output bytes, measured size, quality observation, or target comparison has been produced; the parity conclusion remains UNKNOWN.
No per-round assessment shows the posterior product uncertainty materially reduced; process artifact count increased while product information did not.

required_action: Perform the minimum outcome-producing action and record its direct result: one real source image -> one actual encode -> exact output bytes -> measured size -> quality observation -> comparison against the target -> positive or negative product conclusion. Preserve the existing research artifacts as honest evidence but stop treating them as product progress, closure, or authority for another process-only round. The encode may lose; a negative product result is a product result. State remains UNKNOWN until an outcome witness exists.

objective.outcome_definition: an encoded output that compresses no worse than the target at comparable quality, or an actual encode establishing the candidate loses

minimum_outcome_producing_action.description: run one real source image through one actual bounded encode; measure output bytes, size, and quality; compare to the target

process_activity.artifacts: R1-R8 rounds, MILP construction, candidate logic, seals, receipts, roots, audits

notes: REPRESENTATIVE_EXAMPLE — NOT_A_VERIFIED_HISTORICAL_INCIDENT. No commit id, file path, timestamp, digest, or production receipt is asserted as canonical fact; provenance of the underlying episode is HISTORICAL_CORROBORATION / UNKNOWN, not PRIMARY_PERSISTED. The defining defect is the substitution of accumulated process activity for the product outcome while an admissible outcome-producing action stays deferred and product uncertainty is not reduced. WORK_EXISTS does not imply RESULT_EXISTS. A negative product result (an actual encode that loses) would be a product result, not this incident. This is a laboratory-only pipeline with no deployment/production claim, so AICE-607 is not co-emitted; a paired variant that additionally claimed production readiness could co-emit AICE-607 as the consequence.
